en: A black-and-white vintage postcard featuring a villa-style house with a distinctive gabled roof, balconies, and a small fenced yard. The text at the top in red reads 'Kurpension Dehnicke-Schorr, Bad Pyrmont, Bomberg-Allee 11.' The reverse side has typical postcard formatting with green print and space for a message and address, as well as the words 'Postkarte' and what appears to be a handwritten year, '1913.' Along the edge it reads 'Lichtdruck 25,598 F.B. Göhler, Klotzsche-Dresden'.
